title: RegenCraft
description: Doctor who inspired mod that enables the player to "regenerate".
body:
# RegenCraft

Adds the power of regeneration into Minecraft, allowing players to experience a new way of surviving through the use of a powerful Fob Watch.

To create the Fob Watch, players must first discover the rare item, Time Lord DNA, which is hidden within structures scattered across the world. These ancient discoveries hold the key to unlocking regeneration and crafting a device capable of giving you a second chance when your journey comes to an end.

Explore, collect, craft, and unlock the secrets left behind by the Time Lords. With the Fob Watch in your hands, death is no longer the end — it is only the beginning of a new regeneration.

## Custom Commands

Main command:

`/regeneration` or `/regen`

---

### Player Commands

`/regen info <player>`
Shows your regeneration information or another players.

`/regen flamecolor <colour>`
Changes your regeneration flame colour.

`/regen skinswap`
Shows if your skin changes when regenerating.

`/regen skinswap on/off`
Turns skin changing on or off

`/regen skinreset`
Resets your skin back to normal.

`/regen version`
Shows your current regeneration version.

`/regen version <name>`
Changes your regeneration version.


### Admin Commands

`/regen add <player> <amount>`
Gives a player Time Lord status and regenerations.

`/regen set <player> <amount>`
Sets a player's regeneration amount.

`/regen trigger <player>`
Starts a player's regeneration.

`/regen skip`
Skips your current regeneration.

`/regen reset <player>`
Removes Time Lord status and resets the player.

`/regen bypass on/off`
Turns the regeneration waiting time on or off.


### Advanced Commands

`/regen config`
Shows the mod settings.

`/regen config <setting> <value>`
Changes a mod setting.

---

## Config Settings

`gracePeriodSeconds`
Time before you can regenerate again.

`maxRegenerations`
Maximum regenerations a player can have.

`maxPendingExtensions`
How many times regeneration can be delayed.

`particleDensity`
Controls regeneration particle amount.

`fobWatchRecipeEnabled`
Turns the Fob Watch recipe on/off.

`soundVolumeMultiplier`
Changes regeneration sound volume.

`dnaLootChancePercent`
Chance of finding Time Lord DNA.

`energyVialFollowUpSeconds`
Time limit for using Energy Vials to gain more regenerations.
